short: Weyl lattices are exact duals under the Fock pairing

lean.name: GlobalTheory.T.standard_weyl_lattices_fock_dual
lean.plain: Weyl lattices are exact duals under the Fock pairing
lean.note: In the polynomial model, belonging to either integral Weyl lattice is equivalent to pairing integrally with every vector of the other lattice, within the given representation. This gives the integral pairings needed in the finite sum for a period.
